subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.summary: Proof; algebra and functions; sequences and series; trigonometry; exponentials and logarithms; differentiation, integration, separable differential equations and numerical methods; 2D/3D vectors; descriptive statistics, probability, binomial/normal models and testing; particle dynamics, projectiles, friction and moments.

subjects.name: Further Mathematics
subjects.summary: Pure Core Y540/Y541, Statistics Y542 and Mechanics Y543 only. Complex numbers; matrices; extended vectors and calculus; hyperbolic functions; induction and differential equations; discrete/continuous moments and distributions; sampling, inference, rank tests and regression; work, energy, elastic models, momentum/restitution, centres of mass, circles and variable-force motion.

subjects.name: Physics
subjects.summary: Measurement and practical reasoning; mechanics, materials and energy; electricity, waves and photon ideas; thermal and kinetic-gas models; oscillation, gravitation, astronomy and cosmology; capacitance, electric/magnetic fields and induction; nuclear/particle physics and medical imaging. Equation-sheet constants and relationships are supplied.

subjects.name: Chemistry
subjects.summary: Quantitative amounts and reactions; atomic structure and bonding; periodic/inorganic/transition chemistry; organic mechanisms and synthesis; rates and Arrhenius; Kc/Kp, acids, bases and buffers; enthalpy cycles, entropy and Gibbs; electrode potentials; practical and analytical reasoning including chromatography, IR, mass spectra and NMR.

limits: File checks establish integrity only. Independent subject/content review is documented in research records. No fresh student trials or human learning measurements were run for this release.
